about: Moose Jaw is in southern Saskatchewan, on the Moose Jaw River west of Regina. It is a railway and service city known for underground tunnels tours, a geothermal spa, and 15 Wing—the air base home of the Snowbirds. A brick downtown, Mac the Moose at the highway, and the river valley wrap a compact prairie city. About 34,000 people live in Moose Jaw.
